title: Marco Polo (a tester's call and answer between Stumps, timed)
summary: One Stump says marco in a shared room, every other Stump with the pack answers polo, and the caller times each round trip and counts the lost ones. /marco start [calls] [size 0-3] [gap s], /marco, /marco stop. The same on any firmware since 1.0.0-beta.53, to time a setup before and after an update. Nothing is on the air until a run is started.
hooks: /marco (slash only, up to 3 lines over the mesh)
every 1 s: reads the room's new lines (calls to answer, answers to time) and sends the next call when due
writes its lines with rrc.post() as a person's, so they reach the other Stumps (a plugin's own lines don't); it paces itself: 15 s between calls at least, 30 calls a run, 20 answers a minute

runtime_storage.note: Nothing is stored: a run and its times are gone when the Stump restarts.

wizard.note: Nothing to set. MARCOPOLO_ROOM (lora-mesh) and MARCOPOLO_NICK (Marco) in config.py change the room and the name.
